test_name: Verify User Login with Google Authentication
description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in using their Google account and is redirected to the application dashboard.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Click on the Google authentication button.
Verify that the browser redirects to the Google authentication page.
Log in with valid Google credentials on the Google authentication page.
Verify that the browser redirects back to the Roost.ai dashboard.
Ensure that the dashboard page loads successfully and displays the user's account information.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Google authentication page.
User successfully logs in with Google and is redirected to their dashboard.
Dashboard page displays user's account information.
edge_cases: Google authentication process fails due to invalid credentials.
Redirection to Google authentication page times out.
Redirection back to the dashboard fails.
Dashboard does not load the user's account information after login.
data_requirements: Correct configuration of the Google OAuth client ID and redirect URI.
Access to the Roost.ai login page.
Access to the Google authentication page.
dependencies: Google OAuth integration is correctly configured.
api_interactions: Roost.ai backend API for user authentication.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect to Google authentication page.
Time taken to redirect back to the dashboard.
Page load time of the dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google authentication button has sufficient color contrast.
Verify that the button is focusable using keyboard navigation.
Check for screen reader compatibility on the login page.
Ensure alternative text or ARIA labels for the Google authentication button.
